flow.name: Instrumented cold-flow comparison
flow.description: Compare the flight pressure channel against an independent flow reference. Ambient conditions do not qualify lunar thermal behaviour.

thermal.name: Thermal sensor calibration
thermal.description: Compare the installed channel with a reference across temperature. This can explain an indication without certifying propulsion.

integration.name: Mission integration rehearsal
integration.description: Run the current mission profile with representative task loading. Required before independent readiness review.

crew.name: Crew contingency rehearsal
crew.description: Practise workload sharing and emergency return. Preparation improves procedures, not the hardware.

missions.name: Apollo 9
missions.subtitle: Earth-orbit qualification
missions.objective: Qualify LM independent flight, rendezvous and crew procedures in Earth orbit.

missions.name: Apollo 10
missions.subtitle: Lunar rehearsal
missions.objective: Rehearse lunar navigation, LM descent and rendezvous without landing.

missions.name: Apollo 11
missions.subtitle: Landing and return
missions.objective: Land a crew on the Moon, collect samples and return them safely to Earth.

events.opening: Apollo 9 is approaching. An LM pressure channel showed a transient discrepancy during rehearsal. Flight hardware, a temperature-sensitive instrument and integration workload remain plausible concerns. Existing test summaries do not distinguish them.

outsiders.question: Did the reference instrument see the same pressure change at the same temperature?
Was the independent flow meter on the same time base as the flight channel?
Did the rehearsal include the computer tasks that run together during descent?
